scenes.say: The median American home costs 416,700 dollars. Only one salary fits it comfortably.
Work it backwards. Nine percent down is 37,503 dollars in cash at closing.
That leaves a loan of 379,197 dollars at this week's 7.21 percent rate.
With tax, mortgage insurance and homeowners insurance, it's about 3,286 dollars a month.
At 28 percent of gross pay, that takes an income of about 140,800 dollars a year.

visual.label: income needed for the median home (28% rule)

scenes.say: Redfin's looser math, with 15 percent down and 30 percent of pay, still says 109,796.
Even two median earners together fall short. How short is in the full video on the channel.
